# TestSync Lab

> Remote QA agency for SaaS product teams. Monthly retainers from $999 USD for manual testing, API testing, Playwright automation, performance spot checks, and optional AI product QA. Primary markets: United States, then United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Europe (including Germany). Also serves Pakistan, India, and worldwide.

## Offer
- Basic $999/mo · Growth $1,899/mo · Scale $2,799/mo · Enterprise custom
- ~40 QA hours/week on Basic, Growth, and Scale
- Free QA audit with ~24h business-day reply
- Month-to-month, English reporting, Slack/Jira/GitHub
- AI testing (chatbots, RAG, LLM evals) scoped separately from classic retainers
